title: 5 Best Leadership Coaching Platforms for 2026
summary: Compare the best leadership coaching platforms for 2026, including Torch, BetterUp, CoachHub, EZRA, and Sounding Board. Find the right fit for your team.
body_markdown:
Five options for HR and L&D teams choosing coaching for managers, executives, and leaders guiding organizational change.


Torch is our top pick for organizations that want leadership coaching tied to a specific change, such as an AI rollout or a restructure. The right shortlist depends on who needs coaching, how the program will run, and what leaders need to do differently.


## Key takeaways


- Start with Torch if coaching needs to support a business change and give program sponsors visibility into shared themes.
- Compare BetterUp for distinct manager and executive programs, CoachHub for multilingual delivery, EZRA for defined coaching packages, and Sounding Board for managing an existing coach roster.


## Leadership coaching platforms at a glance


Platform Best fit What to evaluate


Torch Leadership through change Human coaching, Spark practice, and organizational reporting


BetterUp Multiple leadership levels Separate manager and executive offerings


CoachHub Multilingual rollouts Coach availability by language, time zone, and seniority


EZRA Defined coaching programs Program duration, access model, and impact measurement


Sounding Board Existing coach networks Program administration across internal and external coaches


## The best leadership coaching platforms


We compared public product documentation on coaching format, intended audience, program management, and reporting. This guide is published by Torch, which appears first as our recommendation for change-focused coaching. The other picks reflect different buying needs. Features and access can vary by contract.


Looking for a wider list? See our[full comparison of leadership coaching platforms](https://torch.io/compare/) , which covers more providers and evaluation criteria.


### 1. Torch | Best for leading through change


A reorganization can leave managers answering questions about decisions they did not make. An AI rollout can require those same managers to help teams experiment while setting clear boundaries. Torch gives leaders a human coach to work through those situations and Spark AI to practice conversations between sessions. For HR and L&D, Torch documents reporting on engagement, coaching impact, and common themes. Those views can help sponsors see where leaders are getting stuck and where additional support may be useful.


**Ask in the demo** how coaches work with your change priorities, what sponsors can see, and how Torch protects participant confidentiality.


- [Torch enterprise coaching](https://torch.io/enterprise-coaching/)
- [Torch coaching reports](https://help.torch.io/docs/reporting-on-coaching-programs-in-new-torch/)


### 2. BetterUp | Best for multiple leadership levels


BetterUp offers dedicated coaching for senior leaders through Lead and a separate Manage experience for people managers. BetterUp describes Manage as expert coaching, an AI practice partner, peer groups, and team tools such as pulse checks. It’s worth evaluating if you want a single vendor for executive development and a more structured program for managers.


**Ask in the demo** which coaching sessions, AI features, and peer groups are included for each leadership group.


- [BetterUp Lead](https://www.betterup.com/products/betterup-lead)
- [BetterUp Manage](https://www.betterup.com/products/betterup-manage)


### 3. CoachHub | Best for multilingual rollouts


CoachHub matches participants with certified business coaches based on goals, language, and professional context. Its digital coaching experience includes goal tracking and access to the CoachHub Academy between sessions. Consider it when multiple regions need a common rollout and local-language coaching.


**Ask in the demo** to see coach availability for your hardest-to-staff combination of language, time zone, and leadership level.


- [CoachHub coaching experience](https://www.coachhub.com/coaching-experience)


### 4. EZRA | Best for defined coaching programs


EZRA publishes different program formats for different audiences, including EZRA Edge for mid- to senior-level leaders, EZRAx for executives, and Focus for targeted skill development. Its published program descriptions include duration and intended audience, and its FAQ describes EZRA MEASURE as built-in impact measurement. Consider it if you already know which cohorts need coaching and want to compare package terms.


**Ask in the demo** how unlimited access works where offered and how EZRA measures progress for your chosen program.


- [EZRA program options and pricing](https://www.helloezra.com/pricing)
- [EZRA enterprise coaching FAQs](https://www.helloezra.com/faqs)


### 5. Sounding Board | Best for existing coach networks


Sounding Board supports coaching programs that draw on internal and external coaches. Its Transform offering includes access to Sounding Board coaches for individual and group coaching, while its on-demand offering also describes support for internal and third-party coaches. It’s a fit for L&D teams that want to manage programs centrally and retain coaching relationships they already trust.


**Ask in the demo** to see how admins add an existing coach, allocate sessions, and report across coach groups.


- [Sounding Board Transform](https://www.soundingboardinc.com/platform/transform)
- [Sounding Board on-demand coaching](https://www.soundingboardinc.com/solutions/on-demand-coaching/)


## How to choose a leadership coaching platform


1. **Define the behavior.** For example, after a restructure, managers should be able to explain who owns a decision and handle questions they cannot yet answer.
2. **Test coach fit.** Ask to see sample matches for the leadership level, industry context, and languages you actually need. Check how rematching works.
3. **Review reporting and privacy.** Request a sample sponsor dashboard and confirm who can see goals, notes, feedback, and AI practice data.
4. **Compare equivalent quotes.** Use the same cohort size, program length, session access, and support requirements. Ask about implementation and renewal terms.


## Leadership coaching platform FAQs


### What is a leadership coaching platform?


A leadership coaching platform helps organizations deliver and manage coaching for managers and executives. It typically supports coach matching, scheduling, and program reporting. Some platforms also offer assessments, group coaching, or AI practice.


### What is the best leadership coaching platform for enterprise change?


Torch is our pick when leaders need to build skills during a business change. It combines human coaching, Spark AI practice, and reporting that helps program sponsors understand engagement and common themes.


### How much does enterprise leadership coaching cost?


Cost depends on cohort size, coaching access, program length, and implementation support. Ask vendors to quote the same scope and show what changes if you add participants mid-program.


### How do you measure leadership coaching effectiveness?


Choose one or two observable behaviors and establish a baseline before coaching starts. Track participation, then use follow-up feedback from participants and appropriate stakeholders to evaluate whether those behaviors changed. If business metrics move too, consider other factors that could have influenced them.


## Planning a change your leaders need to carry?


Bring one business priority and a target cohort. See how Torch can align coaching, practice, and reporting around the behaviors you want to develop.
